notes: Eight own pages read (seven on dentrix.com and the Henry Schein One API Exchange page on the alias domain henryscheinone.com), all HTTP 200 and not thin. Statements in this bundle about Dentrix Ascend (cloud features, SOC 2, Ascend pricing) and about Dentrix Enterprise (Windows Server and SQL Server requirements, DSO positioning) are about other products and were not coded here; Ascend statements belong to the Dentrix Ascend file, including the answers saying Ascend is a separate product rather than a hosted Dentrix (C04 keeps only statements framed around Dentrix or its maker). Name-only mentions, rankings, market share, review ratings, Townie award votes and comparisons were not coded. Table cells that label Dentrix On-Premise/Cloud or Desktop/Hybrid without naming Ascend were treated as ambiguous and not coded. C03 (Dentrix by Planet DDS): the cited ekimit.com page reads Denticon by Planet DDS, so the answer garbled its source and the cause is recorded as not found; a second cited page (themolarreport.com) failed with a network error and is listed in needs_browser_read only for cause tracing, not for classing. C01 is classed true on the about page's 1997 acquisition by Henry Schein, Inc.; the current publisher is Henry Schein One, a joint venture of Henry Schein Inc. and Internet Brands. C14 (no public pricing) is unverifiable because the pages show no price but do not state that pricing is quote only. Detect AI appears on the home page only inside a customer testimonial. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): the manifest has no browser read for any Dentrix page or for themolarreport.com, so no claim was re-classed and themolarreport.com stays in needs_browser_read. Added from comparison tables: C30 (support offering includes onboarding, training, live support and updates, true on the home page) and one Perplexity table cell as instances of C14 (quote-based) and C16 (around $500 per month). The consistency check kept C03 wrong: the vendor's own comparison page names Henry Schein One as the maker, which contradicts Planet DDS like for like. Table price cells already carried by the same answers (~$350+/mo, ~$350 to $1,200/mo, ~$500/mo) and the Dentrix Enterprise rows were not added.
